entries.reason: iOS 6.1.3 and iOS 4.3 export none of this name, measured in the export trie of CoreVideo in each armv7 shared cache (204 and 178 CoreVideo exports); it is carried with the text the newer release gives it, so that an application that names it loads
entries.effect: the string OpenGLESTextureCacheCompatibility, carried with the text the newer release gives it; nothing of iOS 6 produces it, and where an application hands it to the release the release treats it as it treats any string it does not know
entries.source: the armv7 shared cache of iOS 9.0 through tools/corpus/cache-value.lua, which reads the export trie of CoreVideo and the __cfstring the symbol points at; the host agrees on the same text; the header of iOS 16.4 for the type and the release that added the name
